name: u16_as_be_bytes
proof_scope:
hax/F*; trusted hax extraction; contract functional (value); postcondition: fun result ->
          let result:t_Array u8 (mk_usize 2) = result in
          (result.[ mk_usize 0 ] <: u8) =. (cast (v_val >>! mk_i32 8 <: u16) <: u8) &&
          (result.[ mk_usize 1 ] <: u8) =. (cast (v_val <: u16) <: u8)); self-consistency heuristic=false
